The polygons are not closed on the page: they are sketched as some twenty separate straight strokes, and each is drawn as it stands, through points placed on its ink (a skeleton follower on the ink served as a local aid). Middle and inner strokes: the stroke round the top from the left; two strokes down the left; the heavy stroke from x_2 towards g^{N-1} x_2; the near-horizontal stroke through the point x_2; the faint stroke from x_2 up to the right; at the right a vertical stroke, two diagonals and a heavy dash. The central point is a heavy blot, and the arrow from the legend « pt fixe par » curves down to it. Labels \small where he wrote them: g^{N-1} x_0, g^{N-1} x_1, x_0, x_1, g x_0, g x_1, g^2 x_0, g^2 x_1, g^{N-1} x_2, x_2, g x_2, and the legend (its last word, illegible in the transcription, left out). drawings.description: Une figure à l'encre et au crayon : le complexe trivalent $K$ en traits gras (sommets marqués $0$), sa subdivision barycentrique en traits fins (sommets marqués $0$, $1$, $\infty$), et dix triangles-repères étiquetés $r$ (hachuré), $\tau_{0}r$, $\tau_{1}r$, $\tau_{\infty}r$, $\tau_{0}\tau_{1}r = \rho_{\infty}r$, $\tau_{1}\tau_{0}r = \rho_{\infty}r$, $\tau_{\infty}\tau_{1}r = \rho_{0}r$, $\tau_{0}\tau_{\infty}r = \rho_{0}^{-1}r$, $\tau_{0}\tau_{\infty}r = \tau_{\infty}\tau_{0}r = \rho_{1}r$, avec les sens de rotation et les flèches d'orientation des arêtes.
drawings.kind: trivalent complex K with barycentric subdivision and labelled frames
drawings.notes: Vertices placed once and every edge drawn between them. Bold: the trivalent complex K, vertices of type 0 at A (top left), B, C, D (right) and E (bottom left), edges A-B, B-C, C-D, B-E and the free ends at A, C, D, E. Thin: the barycentric subdivision, from the face centres infinity (top, bottom, and the unlabelled one at the left) to the vertices and to the edge midpoints 1 (on A-B, B-C, C-D, B-E); the line from the top infinity to the bottom one passes through the midpoint of B-C. Nine triangles carry the frame labels (\small) where he wrote them; the triangle r is hatched in pencil. Strike-outs not drawn: the struck strokes at the left; the left-hand legend ("le complexe topologique K ...") is text. The transcription lists ten frame labels; nine triangles are labelled on the page (tau_0 tau_infty r occurs twice, once = rho_0^{-1} r and once = tau_infty tau_0 r = rho_1 r). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Added, each stroke as on the page: the arrowheads and small marks along the thin and bold edges (about twenty-five, each head drawn as its two strokes where it stands, so that its sense is the page's), the small rotation arrows of the frames (tau_0 tau_1 r, tau_1 r, tau_infty tau_1 r, r, tau_1 tau_0 r, tau_0 r, tau_infty r, tau_0 tau_infty r on the right) and the two arrows turning round the midpoint 1 of B-C, each arc with its head; the pencil hatching of r as its six strokes (the earlier patch removed), which stop at the line from the top infinity, as on the page: no pencil stroke crosses tau_0 r on the contrast-raised crop. The line from the bottom infinity to the midpoint 1 of the lower left edge now ends where it ends on the page (1.3 units lower). Overlay with the local TikZ interpreter (not compiled: no TeX in the session): every edge, mark, rotation arrow and label lies on its ink to within about one unit.
